name: Jack
canonical_visual_description: Jack is a 3D stylized cartoon boy with brown tousled hair, large round expressive eyes, small button nose, light freckles on rosy cheeks, solid bright-yellow crew-neck t-shirt, blue denim rolled-up trousers, and red canvas sneakers.

name: Jill
canonical_visual_description: Jill is a 3D stylized cartoon girl with black hair styled in twin braided pigtails tied with pink ribbon clips, side fringe, large animated dark eyes, pastel pink inner t-shirt layered under bright grass-green dungarees, and pinkish-red canvas sneakers.
